name: dsh-desktop
description: Desktop shell for a local DeepSeek Harness checkout

scripts.build: npm run pty:permissions && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:pane
scripts.build:pane: esbuild src/renderer/pane/files.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/files-bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --log-level=warning && esbuild src/renderer/pane/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/pane-bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --loader:.ttf=file --minify --log-level=warning && esbuild src/renderer/terminal/main.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/terminal-bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --minify --log-level=warning && npm run build:workers
scripts.build:renderer: mkdir -p dist/renderer/theme dist/renderer/icons && cp vendor/dsh-theme/*.css dist/renderer/theme/ && cp vendor/vscode-icons/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/icons/ && cp src/renderer/settings.html src/renderer/settings.css src/renderer/settings.js src/renderer/startup.html src/renderer/startup.js src/renderer/splash.css src/renderer/splash.png src/renderer/shell.html src/renderer/shell.css src/renderer/shell.js src/renderer/pane.html src/renderer/pane.css src/renderer/files.html src/renderer/web.html src/renderer/terminal.html src/renderer/terminal.css dist/renderer/ && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css dist/renderer/
scripts.release: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg -c.mac.notarize=true --publish never
